### Thay đổi

Hàm `ApplyExamQuyDoiColumns` giờ lấy hệ số quy đổi chấm thi theo **hình thức thi** thay vì cố định `0.1`:

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[SIM_Schedule_TK_KetQuaThucHienNhaGiao]    Script Date: 14/08/2026 15:25:49 ******/

ALTER Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Schedule_TK_KetQuaThucHienNhaGiao]
(
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester tinyint = null,
	@ScienceIDOfTeacher nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SubjectGroupIDOfTeacher nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TeacherTypeID int = null,
	@chkNOTlaiXe bit = 1
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On

	/* ==================== 0. DANH SÁCH GIÁO VIÊN CẦN THỐNG KÊ ==================== */
	Select
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherID,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName As TeacherName,
		SIM_Teacher.Teachertypeid, --8 là giáo viên(khoa trung tâm) --  5.giáo viên khoa
		Sim_science.Sciencename As ScienceName, -- đơn vị (tên khoa)
		Sim_subjectgroup.ScienceID
	Into #tblTeacherList
	From SIM_Teacher
	Inner Join Sim_subjectgroup On Sim_subjectgroup.Subjectgroupid = SIM_Teacher.Subjectgroupid
	Left Join Sim_science On Sim_science.Scienceid = Sim_subjectgroup.Scienceid -- khoa
	Where (@TeacherID Is Null Or SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = @TeacherID)
		--And (@SubjectGroupIDOfTeacher Is Null Or SIM_Teacher.SubjectGroupID = @SubjectGroupIDOfTeacher)
		And (@TeacherTypeID is null or SIM_Teacher.TeacherTypeID =@TeacherTypeID )
		And (@ScienceIDOfTeacher Is Null Or Sim_subjectgroup.ScienceID = @ScienceIDOfTeacher)

		and (@chkNOTlaiXe = 0 or (@chkNOTlaiXe = 1 and Sim_subjectgroup.ScienceID<>'DTLX'))

	/* ==================== 1. TỔNG SỐ GIỜ COI THI / CHẤM THI ==================== */
	-- Gộp dữ liệu từ 4 vai trò: TeacherID1, TeacherID2, ReviewTeacherID1, ReviewTeacherID2

	-- TeacherID1 (giám thị 1)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID1 As TeacherID,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		0 As SoBai_ChamThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo
	Into #tblBangThongKe
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID1
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID1 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- TeacherID2 (giám thị 2)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2 As TeacherID,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		0 As SoBai_ChamThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,

		Case 
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
		When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- ReviewTeacherID1 (chấm thi 1)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1 As TeacherID,
		0 As SoGio_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- ReviewTeacherID2 (chấm thi 2)
	Select
	
		SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2 As TeacherID,
		0 As SoGio_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case 
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	-- Tổng hợp coi thi / chấm thi theo giáo viên
	Select
		#tblBangThongKe.TeacherID,
		Sum(#tblBangThongKe.SoGio_CoiThi) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		Sum(#tblBangThongKe.SoBai_ChamThi) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		Cast(Sum(#tblBangThongKe.GioQuyDoi_CoiThi * #tblBangThongKe.HeSo) * 0.3 As Decimal(18,2)) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		Cast(Sum(#tblBangThongKe.GioQuyDoi_ChamThi * #tblBangThongKe.HeSo) * 0.1 As Decimal(18,2)) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi

	Into #tbl_CoiThi_ChamThi
	From #tblBangThongKe
	Group By #tblBangThongKe.TeacherID

	Drop Table #tblBangThongKe

	/* ==================== 2. GIỜ CHUẨN ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan.StandardQuantity), 0) As StandardQuantity_DinhMucGiangDay,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan.RealStandardQuantity), 0) As RealStandardQuantity_DinhMucGiangDayNamHoc
	Into #tbl_GioChuan
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan On SIM_TeachingPlan.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 2b. GIỜ KIÊM NHIỆM ==================== */
	-- Mỗi giáo viên có thể có nhiều kiêm nhiệm, cần Sum lại để tránh nhân dòng
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.Value), 0) As RatioPositionValue_DinhMucGiamKiemNhiem
	Into #tbl_KiemNhiem
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition On SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 3. GIỜ CÔNG VIỆC: HỌC TẬP, BỒI DƯỠNG / HOẠT ĐỘNG KHÁC ==================== */
	-- Áp dụng ngưỡng (cap):
	--   Khoa <> 'DTLX': HTBD=26, HDKhac=52
	--   Khoa = 'DTLX': HTBD=26, HDKhac=26
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W34_HocTapBoiDuong,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 52
			Then 52
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W35_HoatDongKhac
	Into #tbl_Gio_CV_HD
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 4. GIỜ NCKH THỰC HIỆN ==================== */
	-- Mỗi giáo viên có thể có nhiều bản ghi NCKH, cần Sum lại để tránh nhân dòng
	-- Áp dụng ngưỡng: Khoa <> 'DTLX' cap 78, Khoa = 'DTLX' không giới hạn
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.ResearchNow), 0)  +  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.SavePrev), 0) > 78
			Then 78
			Else  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.ResearchNow), 0)  +  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.SavePrev), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As ResearchNow_NCKH
	Into #tbl_Gio_NCKH
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeResearch On SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 5. GIỜ SOẠN ĐỀ ==================== */
	-- Lấy RequestTotal từ SIM_TeachingTimeAdded, TeacherWorkID IN (1,2,3,4,5) = Soạn đề
	-- Group theo giáo viên
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.RequestTotal), 0) As SoGioSoanDe
	Into #tblSoanDe
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID In (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 6. SỐ GIỜ GIẢNG DẠY THỰC TẾ (có hệ số) ==================== */
	-- Logic đồng bộ SIM_WeekDetailPlan_BangTinhGioDayGiangVien_New (@IsContractTeaching = 0)

	-- 6a. Môn lớp trong niên học / học kỳ
	Select
		ClassSubjectID,
		ClassID,
		SubjectID,
		YearID,
		Semester,
		TheoryQuantity,
		PracticeQuantity,
		TestQuantity,
		TheoryQuantityOfTraining,
		PracticeQuantityOfTraining,
		TestQuantityOfTraining,
		ReplaceTeacherID,
		TeachingPrice,
		ClassSubjectStatus,
		ClassSubjectStatusType,
		MethodTestID,
		IsContractTeaching,
		IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		TeachingBy,
		Case When IsNull(TeachingByTheory, '') <> '' Then TeachingByTheory Else TeachingBy End As TeachingByTheory,
		Case When IsNull(TeachingByPractice, '') <> '' Then TeachingByPractice Else TeachingBy End As TeachingByPractice
	Into #tblCSDataGD
	From SIM_Class_Subject
	Where YearID = @YearID
		And (@Semester Is Null Or Semester = @Semester)
		And IsIgnoreTeachingTime = 0
		And (
			ClassSubjectStatus Not In (1, 2)
			Or ClassSubjectStatusType In (1, 2)
		)

	Select
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		tbl.YearID,
		tbl.Semester,
		tbl.ClassID,
		tbl.SubjectID,
		tbl.MethodTestID,
		tbl.TeachingBy,
		tbl.TeachingByTheory,
		tbl.TeachingByPractice,
		tbl.ReplaceTeacherID,
		tbl.ClassSubjectStatus,
		tbl.ClassSubjectStatusType,
		tbl.IsContractTeaching,
		tbl.IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		tbl.TeachingPrice,
		Case When SIM_Class.ClassType = 2 Then s2.ClassID Else tbl.ClassID End As ClassID_Origin,
		SIM_Class.ClassSize,
		SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID,
		SIM_Class.Specialbranchid,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectGroupID,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectSet,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.TheoryQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.TheoryQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.TheoryQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else tbl.TheoryQuantity
		End As TheoryQuantity,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.PracticeQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.PracticeQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.PracticeQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else tbl.PracticeQuantity
		End As PracticeQuantity,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.TestQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.TestQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.TestQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else 0
		End As TestQuantity
	Into #tblCSGD
	From #tblCSDataGD tbl
	Inner Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = tbl.SubjectID
	Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = tbl.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject s2 On s2.ClassSubjectID = SIM_Class.ClassSubjectID

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set TheoryQuantity = TheoryQuantity + Case When PracticeQuantity = 0 Then TestQuantity Else 0 End,
		PracticeQuantity = PracticeQuantity + Case When PracticeQuantity > 0 Then TestQuantity Else 0 End

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set TheoryQuantity = 0
	Where ClassSubjectStatus = 1

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set PracticeQuantity = 0
	Where ClassSubjectStatus = 2

	-- 6b. Sĩ số: chỉ SV có trong sổ điểm (theo MHL logic) — đồng bộ BangTinhGioDayGiangVien_New
	Select
		ClassSubjectID,
		Sum(ClassSize) As ClassSize
	Into #tblClassSubjectSize
	From (
		Select
			cs.ClassSubjectID,
			Count(sm.SubjectMarkID) As ClassSize
		From #tblCSDataGD cs
		Left Join (
			Select
				sm.SubjectMarkID,
				sm.ClassSubjectID,
				sm.LogicClassSubjectID
			From SIM_SubjectMark sm
			Inner Join SIM_Student st On st.StudentID = sm.StudentID
				And st.IsDeleted = 0
		) sm On sm.ClassSubjectID = cs.ClassSubjectID
		Group By cs.ClassSubjectID

		Union All

		Select
			cs.ClassSubjectID,
			Count(sm.SubjectMarkID) As ClassSize
		From #tblCSDataGD cs
		Left Join (
			Select
				sm.SubjectMarkID,
				sm.ClassSubjectID,
				sm.LogicClassSubjectID
			From SIM_SubjectMark sm
			Inner Join SIM_Student st On st.StudentID = sm.StudentID
				And st.IsDeleted = 0
		) sm On sm.LogicClassSubjectID = cs.ClassSubjectID
			And IsNull(sm.LogicClassSubjectID, 0) <> IsNull(sm.ClassSubjectID, 0)
		Group By cs.ClassSubjectID
	) tbl
	Group By ClassSubjectID

	-- 6c. Đếm giờ từ TKB thực tế (ưu tiên, @IsContractTeaching = 0)
	Select
		s.TeacherID,
		s.ClassSubjectID,
		s.Semester,
		Sum(Case When s.IsPractice = 0 Then 1 Else 0 End) As TotalQuantity_Theory,
		Sum(Case When s.IsPractice = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) As TotalQuantity_Practice
	Into #tblScheduleHoursDetail
	From SIM_Schedule s
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList t On t.TeacherID = s.TeacherID
	Inner Join #tblCSDataGD tblCS On tblCS.ClassSubjectID = s.ClassSubjectID
	Where s.IsOff = 0
		And s.ClassSubjectID > 0
		And s.YearID = @YearID
		And (@Semester Is Null Or s.Semester = @Semester)
		And (
			(s.IsPractice = 0 And tblCS.IsContractTeaching = 0)
			Or (s.IsPractice = 1 And tblCS.IsContractTeachingOfPractice = 0)
		)
	Group By s.TeacherID,
		s.ClassSubjectID,
		s.Semester

	-- 6d. Fallback: kế hoạch tuần khi chưa có TKB
	Select
		tblCS.Semester,
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End As TeacherID,
		Case
			When tblCS.SubjectSet = 6 Then Max(tblCS.TheoryQuantity)
			Else Sum(Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tbl.Quantity Else 0 End)
		End As TotalQuantity_Theory,
		Case
			When tblCS.SubjectSet = 6 Then Max(tblCS.PracticeQuantity)
			Else Sum(Case When tbl.IsPractice = 1 Then tbl.Quantity Else 0 End)
		End As TotalQuantity_Practice
	Into #tblWeekPlanHoursGD
	From SIM_WeekDetailPlan tbl
	Inner Join #tblCSGD tblCS On tblCS.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList t On t.TeacherID = Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End
	Where (
			(tbl.IsPractice = 0 And tblCS.IsContractTeaching = 0)
			Or (tbl.IsPractice = 1 And tblCS.IsContractTeachingOfPractice = 0)
		)
		And Not Exists (
			Select 1
			From #tblScheduleHoursDetail sh
			Where sh.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
				And sh.TeacherID = Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End
				And sh.Semester = tblCS.Semester
		)
	Group By tblCS.Semester,
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End,
		tblCS.SubjectSet,
		tblCS.TheoryQuantity,
		tblCS.PracticeQuantity

	-- 6e. Gộp nguồn giờ: Schedule + WeekPlan
	Select
		TeacherID,
		ClassSubjectID,
		Semester,
		TotalQuantity_Theory,
		TotalQuantity_Practice
	Into #tblHoursGD
	From #tblScheduleHoursDetail
	Where IsNull(TotalQuantity_Theory, 0) + IsNull(TotalQuantity_Practice, 0) > 0

	Insert Into #tblHoursGD (TeacherID, ClassSubjectID, Semester, TotalQuantity_Theory, TotalQuantity_Practice)
	Select
		TeacherID,
		ClassSubjectID,
		Semester,
		TotalQuantity_Theory,
		TotalQuantity_Practice
	From #tblWeekPlanHoursGD
	Where IsNull(TotalQuantity_Theory, 0) + IsNull(TotalQuantity_Practice, 0) > 0

	-- 6f. Gom theo giáo viên, nhân hệ số theo bậc/môn + sĩ số (công thức QuyDoiGio chuẩn)
	Select
		h.TeacherID,

		Cast(Sum(IsNull(h.TotalQuantity_Practice, 0)) As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalQuantity_Practice,

			* Case
				When cs.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And cs.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And cs.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82

				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or cs.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
				Else 1.00
			End

				When Case When IsNull(css.ClassSize, 0) > 0 Then css.ClassSize Else IsNull(cs.ClassSize, 0) End Between 36 And 50 Then 1.10
				When Case When IsNull(css.ClassSize, 0) > 0 Then css.ClassSize Else IsNull(cs.ClassSize, 0) End >= 51 Then 1.20

		) As Decimal(18,2)) As TongLTTH
	Into #tblScheduleHours

			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63

	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID

	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID

		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

		SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1 As TeacherID,

		Case

			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78

	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- ReviewTeacherID2 (chấm thi 2)
	Select
	
		SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2 As TeacherID,
		0 As SoGio_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case 
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	-- Tổng hợp coi thi / chấm thi theo giáo viên
	Select
		#tblBangThongKe.TeacherID,
		Sum(#tblBangThongKe.SoGio_CoiThi) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		Sum(#tblBangThongKe.SoBai_ChamThi) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		Cast(Sum(#tblBangThongKe.GioQuyDoi_CoiThi * #tblBangThongKe.HeSo) * 0.3 As Decimal(18,2)) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		Cast(Sum(#tblBangThongKe.GioQuyDoi_ChamThi * #tblBangThongKe.HeSo) * 0.1 As Decimal(18,2)) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi

	Into #tbl_CoiThi_ChamThi
	From #tblBangThongKe
	Group By #tblBangThongKe.TeacherID

	Drop Table #tblBangThongKe

	/* ==================== 2. GIỜ CHUẨN ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan.StandardQuantity), 0) As StandardQuantity_DinhMucGiangDay,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan.RealStandardQuantity), 0) As RealStandardQuantity_DinhMucGiangDayNamHoc
	Into #tbl_GioChuan
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan On SIM_TeachingPlan.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 2b. GIỜ KIÊM NHIỆM ==================== */
	-- Mỗi giáo viên có thể có nhiều kiêm nhiệm, cần Sum lại để tránh nhân dòng
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.Value), 0) As RatioPositionValue_DinhMucGiamKiemNhiem
	Into #tbl_KiemNhiem
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition On SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 3. GIỜ CÔNG VIỆC: HỌC TẬP, BỒI DƯỠNG / HOẠT ĐỘNG KHÁC ==================== */
	-- Áp dụng ngưỡng (cap):
	--   Khoa <> 'DTLX': HTBD=26, HDKhac=52
	--   Khoa = 'DTLX': HTBD=26, HDKhac=26
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W34_HocTapBoiDuong,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 52
			Then 52
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W35_HoatDongKhac
	Into #tbl_Gio_CV_HD
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 4. GIỜ NCKH THỰC HIỆN ==================== */
	-- Mỗi giáo viên có thể có nhiều bản ghi NCKH, cần Sum lại để tránh nhân dòng
	-- Áp dụng ngưỡng: Khoa <> 'DTLX' cap 78, Khoa = 'DTLX' không giới hạn
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.ResearchNow), 0)  +  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.SavePrev), 0) > 78
			Then 78
			Else  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.ResearchNow), 0)  +  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.SavePrev), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As ResearchNow_NCKH
	Into #tbl_Gio_NCKH
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeResearch On SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 5. GIỜ SOẠN ĐỀ ==================== */
	-- Lấy RequestTotal từ SIM_TeachingTimeAdded, TeacherWorkID IN (1,2,3,4,5) = Soạn đề
	-- Group theo giáo viên
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.RequestTotal), 0) As SoGioSoanDe
	Into #tblSoanDe
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID In (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 6. SỐ GIỜ GIẢNG DẠY THỰC TẾ (có hệ số) ==================== */
	-- Logic đồng bộ SIM_WeekDetailPlan_BangTinhGioDayGiangVien_New (@IsContractTeaching = 0)

	-- 6a. Môn lớp trong niên học / học kỳ
	Select
		ClassSubjectID,
		ClassID,
		SubjectID,
		YearID,
		Semester,
		TheoryQuantity,
		PracticeQuantity,
		TestQuantity,
		TheoryQuantityOfTraining,
		PracticeQuantityOfTraining,
		TestQuantityOfTraining,
		ReplaceTeacherID,
		TeachingPrice,
		ClassSubjectStatus,
		ClassSubjectStatusType,
		MethodTestID,
		IsContractTeaching,
		IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		TeachingBy,
		Case When IsNull(TeachingByTheory, '') <> '' Then TeachingByTheory Else TeachingBy End As TeachingByTheory,
		Case When IsNull(TeachingByPractice, '') <> '' Then TeachingByPractice Else TeachingBy End As TeachingByPractice
	Into #tblCSDataGD
	From SIM_Class_Subject
	Where YearID = @YearID
		And (@Semester Is Null Or Semester = @Semester)
		And IsIgnoreTeachingTime = 0
		And (
			ClassSubjectStatus Not In (1, 2)
			Or ClassSubjectStatusType In (1, 2)
		)

	Select
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		tbl.YearID,
		tbl.Semester,
		tbl.ClassID,
		tbl.SubjectID,
		tbl.MethodTestID,
		tbl.TeachingBy,
		tbl.TeachingByTheory,
		tbl.TeachingByPractice,
		tbl.ReplaceTeacherID,
		tbl.ClassSubjectStatus,
		tbl.ClassSubjectStatusType,
		tbl.IsContractTeaching,
		tbl.IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		tbl.TeachingPrice,
		Case When SIM_Class.ClassType = 2 Then s2.ClassID Else tbl.ClassID End As ClassID_Origin,
		SIM_Class.ClassSize,
		SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID,
		SIM_Class.Specialbranchid,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectGroupID,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectSet,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.TheoryQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.TheoryQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.TheoryQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else tbl.TheoryQuantity
		End As TheoryQuantity,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.PracticeQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.PracticeQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.PracticeQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else tbl.PracticeQuantity
		End As PracticeQuantity,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.TestQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.TestQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.TestQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else 0
		End As TestQuantity
	Into #tblCSGD
	From #tblCSDataGD tbl
	Inner Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = tbl.SubjectID
	Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = tbl.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject s2 On s2.ClassSubjectID = SIM_Class.ClassSubjectID

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set TheoryQuantity = TheoryQuantity + Case When PracticeQuantity = 0 Then TestQuantity Else 0 End,
		PracticeQuantity = PracticeQuantity + Case When PracticeQuantity > 0 Then TestQuantity Else 0 End

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set TheoryQuantity = 0
	Where ClassSubjectStatus = 1

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set PracticeQuantity = 0
	Where ClassSubjectStatus = 2

	-- 6b. Sĩ số: chỉ SV có trong sổ điểm (theo MHL logic) — đồng bộ BangTinhGioDayGiangVien_New
	Select
		ClassSubjectID,
		Sum(ClassSize) As ClassSize
	Into #tblClassSubjectSize
	From (
		Select
			cs.ClassSubjectID,
			Count(sm.SubjectMarkID) As ClassSize
		From #tblCSDataGD cs
		Left Join (
			Select
				sm.SubjectMarkID,
				sm.ClassSubjectID,
				sm.LogicClassSubjectID
			From SIM_SubjectMark sm
			Inner Join SIM_Student st On st.StudentID = sm.StudentID
				And st.IsDeleted = 0
		) sm On sm.ClassSubjectID = cs.ClassSubjectID
		Group By cs.ClassSubjectID

		Union All

		Select
			cs.ClassSubjectID,
			Count(sm.SubjectMarkID) As ClassSize
		From #tblCSDataGD cs
		Left Join (
			Select
				sm.SubjectMarkID,
				sm.ClassSubjectID,
				sm.LogicClassSubjectID
			From SIM_SubjectMark sm
			Inner Join SIM_Student st On st.StudentID = sm.StudentID
				And st.IsDeleted = 0
		) sm On sm.LogicClassSubjectID = cs.ClassSubjectID
			And IsNull(sm.LogicClassSubjectID, 0) <> IsNull(sm.ClassSubjectID, 0)
		Group By cs.ClassSubjectID
	) tbl
	Group By ClassSubjectID

	-- 6c. Đếm giờ từ TKB thực tế (ưu tiên, @IsContractTeaching = 0)
	Select
		s.TeacherID,
		s.ClassSubjectID,
		s.Semester,
		Sum(Case When s.IsPractice = 0 Then 1 Else 0 End) As TotalQuantity_Theory,
		Sum(Case When s.IsPractice = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) As TotalQuantity_Practice
	Into #tblScheduleHoursDetail
	From SIM_Schedule s
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList t On t.TeacherID = s.TeacherID
	Inner Join #tblCSDataGD tblCS On tblCS.ClassSubjectID = s.ClassSubjectID
	Where s.IsOff = 0
		And s.ClassSubjectID > 0
		And s.YearID = @YearID
		And (@Semester Is Null Or s.Semester = @Semester)
		And (
			(s.IsPractice = 0 And tblCS.IsContractTeaching = 0)
			Or (s.IsPractice = 1 And tblCS.IsContractTeachingOfPractice = 0)
		)
	Group By s.TeacherID,
		s.ClassSubjectID,
		s.Semester

	-- 6d. Fallback: kế hoạch tuần khi chưa có TKB
	Select
		tblCS.Semester,
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End As TeacherID,
		Case
			When tblCS.SubjectSet = 6 Then Max(tblCS.TheoryQuantity)
			Else Sum(Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tbl.Quantity Else 0 End)
		End As TotalQuantity_Theory,
		Case
			When tblCS.SubjectSet = 6 Then Max(tblCS.PracticeQuantity)
			Else Sum(Case When tbl.IsPractice = 1 Then tbl.Quantity Else 0 End)
		End As TotalQuantity_Practice
	Into #tblWeekPlanHoursGD
	From SIM_WeekDetailPlan tbl
	Inner Join #tblCSGD tblCS On tblCS.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList t On t.TeacherID = Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End
	Where (
			(tbl.IsPractice = 0 And tblCS.IsContractTeaching = 0)
			Or (tbl.IsPractice = 1 And tblCS.IsContractTeachingOfPractice = 0)
		)
		And Not Exists (
			Select 1
			From #tblScheduleHoursDetail sh
			Where sh.ClassSubjectID = tbl.ClassSubjectID
				And sh.TeacherID = Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End
				And sh.Semester = tblCS.Semester
		)
	Group By tblCS.Semester,
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		Case When tbl.IsPractice = 0 Then tblCS.TeachingByTheory Else tblCS.TeachingByPractice End,
		tblCS.SubjectSet,
		tblCS.TheoryQuantity,
		tblCS.PracticeQuantity

	-- 6e. Gộp nguồn giờ: Schedule + WeekPlan
	Select
		TeacherID,
		ClassSubjectID,
		Semester,
		TotalQuantity_Theory,
		TotalQuantity_Practice
	Into #tblHoursGD
	From #tblScheduleHoursDetail
	Where IsNull(TotalQuantity_Theory, 0) + IsNull(TotalQuantity_Practice, 0) > 0

	Insert Into #tblHoursGD (TeacherID, ClassSubjectID, Semester, TotalQuantity_Theory, TotalQuantity_Practice)
	Select
		TeacherID,
		ClassSubjectID,
		Semester,
		TotalQuantity_Theory,
		TotalQuantity_Practice
	From #tblWeekPlanHoursGD
	Where IsNull(TotalQuantity_Theory, 0) + IsNull(TotalQuantity_Practice, 0) > 0

	-- 6f. Gom theo giáo viên, nhân hệ số theo bậc/môn + sĩ số (công thức QuyDoiGio chuẩn)
	Select
		h.TeacherID,
		Cast(Sum(IsNull(h.TotalQuantity_Theory, 0)) As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalQuantity_Theory,
		Cast(Sum(IsNull(h.TotalQuantity_Practice, 0)) As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalQuantity_Practice,
		Cast(Sum(
			(IsNull(h.TotalQuantity_Theory, 0) + IsNull(h.TotalQuantity_Practice, 0))
			* Case
				When cs.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And cs.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And cs.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
				When cs.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or cs.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
				Else 1.00
			End
			* Case
				When Case When IsNull(css.ClassSize, 0) > 0 Then css.ClassSize Else IsNull(cs.ClassSize, 0) End <= 35 Then 1.00
				When Case When IsNull(css.ClassSize, 0) > 0 Then css.ClassSize Else IsNull(cs.ClassSize, 0) End Between 36 And 50 Then 1.10
				When Case When IsNull(css.ClassSize, 0) > 0 Then css.ClassSize Else IsNull(cs.ClassSize, 0) End >= 51 Then 1.20
				Else 1.00
			End
		) As Decimal(18,2)) As TongLTTH
	Into #tblScheduleHours
	From #tblHoursGD h
	Inner Join #tblCSGD cs On cs.ClassSubjectID = h.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join #tblClassSubjectSize css On css.ClassSubjectID = h.ClassSubjectID
	Group By h.TeacherID

	Drop Table #tblCSDataGD
	Drop Table #tblCSGD
	Drop Table #tblClassSubjectSize
	Drop Table #tblScheduleHoursDetail
	Drop Table #tblWeekPlanHoursGD
	Drop Table #tblHoursGD

	/* ==================== MAIN SELECT: TỔNG HỢP TẤT CẢ ==================== */
	Select
		-- Thông tin giáo viên
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherFirstName,
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherLastName,
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherName,

	Left Join #tbl_Gio_CV_HD On #tbl_Gio_CV_HD.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	-- Dọn dẹp temp tables
	Drop Table #tblTeacherList

	Drop Table #tbl_KiemNhiem
	Drop Table #tbl_Gio_CV_HD

End

        MethodTestID 3 (TH - Thực hành), 4 (VD - Vấn đáp) => * 0.2

ALTER Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Schedule_TK_KetQuaThucHienNhaGiao]
(
	@YearID int = null,
	@Semester tinyint = null,
	@ScienceIDOfTeacher nvarchar(50) = null,
	@SubjectGroupIDOfTeacher nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TeacherID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@TeacherTypeID int = null,
	@chkNOTlaiXe bit = 1
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On

	/* ==================== 0. DANH SÁCH GIÁO VIÊN CẦN THỐNG KÊ ==================== */
	Select
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherID,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName,
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName As TeacherName,
		SIM_Teacher.Teachertypeid,
		Sim_science.Sciencename As ScienceName,
		Sim_subjectgroup.ScienceID
	Into #tblTeacherList
	From SIM_Teacher
	Inner Join Sim_subjectgroup On Sim_subjectgroup.Subjectgroupid = SIM_Teacher.Subjectgroupid
	Left Join Sim_science On Sim_science.Scienceid = Sim_subjectgroup.Scienceid
	Where (@TeacherID Is Null Or SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = @TeacherID)
		And (@TeacherTypeID is null or SIM_Teacher.TeacherTypeID =@TeacherTypeID )
		And (@ScienceIDOfTeacher Is Null Or Sim_subjectgroup.ScienceID = @ScienceIDOfTeacher)
		and (@chkNOTlaiXe = 0 or (@chkNOTlaiXe = 1 and Sim_subjectgroup.ScienceID<>'DTLX'))

	/* ==================== 1. TỔNG SỐ GIỜ COI THI / CHẤM THI ==================== */

	-- TeacherID1 (giám thị 1)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID1 As TeacherID,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		0 As SoBai_ChamThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.MethodTestID, 0) As MethodTestID
	Into #tblBangThongKe
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID1
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID1 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- TeacherID2 (giám thị 2)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2 As TeacherID,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		0 As SoBai_ChamThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSession.TimeLen, 0) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.MethodTestID, 0) As MethodTestID
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.TeacherID2 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- ReviewTeacherID1 (chấm thi 1)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1 As TeacherID,
		0 As SoGio_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.MethodTestID, 0) As MethodTestID
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID1 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	Union All

	-- ReviewTeacherID2 (chấm thi 2)
	Select
		SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2 As TeacherID,
		0 As SoGio_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		0 As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.DoneExamCount, 0) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi,
		Case
			When Sim_class.Specialbranchid = 'BDGV' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.93
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' And SIM_Subject.SubjectName In (N'Tiếng Anh', N'Tin học', N'Giáo dục chính trị', N'Pháp luật', N'Giáo dục Quốc phòng và An ninh', N'Giáo dục thể chất') Then 0.82
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'C' Then 1.00
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'T' Then 0.88
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = '5' Then 0.63
			When SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = 'S' Or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID In ('TT', 'N', 'BDCD', 'TX') Then 0.78
			Else 1.00
		End As HeSo,
		IsNull(SIM_TestSchedule.MethodTestID, 0) As MethodTestID
	From SIM_TestSchedule
	Inner Join #tblTeacherList On #tblTeacherList.TeacherID = SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2
	Left Join SIM_TestSession On SIM_TestSession.TestSessionID = SIM_TestSchedule.TestSessionID
	Left Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_TestSchedule.ClassSubjectID
	Left Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID
	Where (SIM_TestSchedule.ReviewTeacherID2 Is Not Null)
		And (@YearID Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.YearID = @YearID)
		And (@Semester Is Null Or SIM_TestSchedule.Semester = @Semester)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.Week > 0)
		And (SIM_TestSchedule.ClassID Is Not Null)

	-- Tổng hợp coi thi / chấm thi theo giáo viên
	Select
		#tblBangThongKe.TeacherID,
		Sum(#tblBangThongKe.SoGio_CoiThi) As SoGio_CoiThi,
		Sum(#tblBangThongKe.SoBai_ChamThi) As SoBai_ChamThi,
		Cast(Sum(#tblBangThongKe.GioQuyDoi_CoiThi * #tblBangThongKe.HeSo) * 0.3 As Decimal(18,2)) As GioQuyDoi_CoiThi,
		Cast(Sum(
			#tblBangThongKe.GioQuyDoi_ChamThi
			* #tblBangThongKe.HeSo
			* Case
				When #tblBangThongKe.MethodTestID In (3, 4) Then 0.2
				Else 0.1
			  End
		) As Decimal(18,2)) As GioQuyDoi_ChamThi
	Into #tbl_CoiThi_ChamThi
	From #tblBangThongKe
	Group By #tblBangThongKe.TeacherID

	Drop Table #tblBangThongKe

	/* ==================== 2. GIỜ CHUẨN ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan.StandardQuantity), 0) As StandardQuantity_DinhMucGiangDay,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan.RealStandardQuantity), 0) As RealStandardQuantity_DinhMucGiangDayNamHoc
	Into #tbl_GioChuan
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan On SIM_TeachingPlan.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 2b. GIỜ KIÊM NHIỆM ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.Value), 0) As RatioPositionValue_DinhMucGiamKiemNhiem
	Into #tbl_KiemNhiem
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition On SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingPlan_RatioPosition.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 3. GIỜ CÔNG VIỆC: HỌC TẬP, BỒI DƯỠNG / HOẠT ĐỘNG KHÁC ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 34 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W34_HocTapBoiDuong,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 52
			Then 52
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) = 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0) > 26
			Then 26
			Else IsNull(Sum(Case When SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID = 35 Then SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TotalFinal Else 0 End), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As TotalFinal_W35_HoatDongKhac
	Into #tbl_Gio_CV_HD
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 4. GIỜ NCKH THỰC HIỆN ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		Cast(Case
			When Max(#tblTeacherList.ScienceID) <> 'DTLX'
				And IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.ResearchNow), 0)  +  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.SavePrev), 0) > 78
			Then 78
			Else  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.ResearchNow), 0)  +  IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.SavePrev), 0)
		End As Decimal(18,2)) As ResearchNow_NCKH
	Into #tbl_Gio_NCKH
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeResearch On SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.Semester = @Semester
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 5. GIỜ SOẠN ĐỀ ==================== */
	Select
		#tblTeacherList.TeacherID,
		IsNull(Sum(SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.RequestTotal), 0) As SoGioSoanDe
	Into #tblSoanDe
	From #tblTeacherList
	Left Join SIM_TeachingTimeAdded On SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID = #tblTeacherList.TeacherID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.YearID = @YearID
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.Semester = @Semester
		And SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherWorkID In (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
	Group By #tblTeacherList.TeacherID

	/* ==================== 6. SỐ GIỜ GIẢNG DẠY THỰC TẾ (có hệ số) ==================== */

	Select
		ClassSubjectID,
		ClassID,
		SubjectID,
		YearID,
		Semester,
		TheoryQuantity,
		PracticeQuantity,
		TestQuantity,
		TheoryQuantityOfTraining,
		PracticeQuantityOfTraining,
		TestQuantityOfTraining,
		ReplaceTeacherID,
		TeachingPrice,
		ClassSubjectStatus,
		ClassSubjectStatusType,
		MethodTestID,
		IsContractTeaching,
		IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		TeachingBy,
		Case When IsNull(TeachingByTheory, '') <> '' Then TeachingByTheory Else TeachingBy End As TeachingByTheory,
		Case When IsNull(TeachingByPractice, '') <> '' Then TeachingByPractice Else TeachingBy End As TeachingByPractice
	Into #tblCSDataGD
	From SIM_Class_Subject
	Where YearID = @YearID
		And (@Semester Is Null Or Semester = @Semester)
		And IsIgnoreTeachingTime = 0
		And (
			ClassSubjectStatus Not In (1, 2)
			Or ClassSubjectStatusType In (1, 2)
		)

	Select
		tbl.ClassSubjectID,
		tbl.YearID,
		tbl.Semester,
		tbl.ClassID,
		tbl.SubjectID,
		tbl.MethodTestID,
		tbl.TeachingBy,
		tbl.TeachingByTheory,
		tbl.TeachingByPractice,
		tbl.ReplaceTeacherID,
		tbl.ClassSubjectStatus,
		tbl.ClassSubjectStatusType,
		tbl.IsContractTeaching,
		tbl.IsContractTeachingOfPractice,
		tbl.TeachingPrice,
		Case When SIM_Class.ClassType = 2 Then s2.ClassID Else tbl.ClassID End As ClassID_Origin,
		SIM_Class.ClassSize,
		SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID,
		SIM_Class.Specialbranchid,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectGroupID,
		SIM_Subject.SubjectSet,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.TheoryQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.TheoryQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.TheoryQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else tbl.TheoryQuantity
		End As TheoryQuantity,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.PracticeQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.PracticeQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.PracticeQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else tbl.PracticeQuantity
		End As PracticeQuantity,
		Case
			When SubjectSet = 5 Then tbl.TestQuantity
			When SubjectSet = 6 Then tbl.TestQuantityOfTraining
			When SubjectSet = 7 Then Round(tbl.TestQuantity * 15.0 / 40, 0)
			Else 0
		End As TestQuantity
	Into #tblCSGD
	From #tblCSDataGD tbl
	Inner Join SIM_Subject On SIM_Subject.SubjectID = tbl.SubjectID
	Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = tbl.ClassID
	Left Join SIM_Class_Subject s2 On s2.ClassSubjectID = SIM_Class.ClassSubjectID

	Update #tblCSGD
	Set TheoryQuantity = TheoryQuantity + Case When PracticeQuantity = 0 Then TestQuantity Else 0 End,
		PracticeQuantity = PracticeQuantity + Case When PracticeQuantity > 0 Then TestQuantity Else 0 End
